decision: Merge only trusted validation reuse after isolated same-build experiments and confirmation; metric descriptors, observer projection and scheduler changes are unimplemented.

build_control.method: Both control and prototype built through uv/maturin release wheels with identical Cargo.lock/profile/features. Control binary is byte-identical to production baseline.
build_control.discarded_exploratory_build: Direct cargo build had a different native hash and noisy/unfavorable results; not used to approve the change.

limitations: Only local fresh scalar publication avoids the two validation scans; observer paths and partial/general records retain validation.
